europe_now.title: German far-right AfD achieves historic election victory in Saxony-Anhalt
europe_now.summary: The far-right Alternative for Germany party has secured a historic victory in the Saxony-Anhalt state election, prompting serious concern among mainstream political figures. The result is being described as a watershed moment that could reshape the German political landscape, with the party demanding to be included in coalition negotiations.

europe_now.title: Ukraine faces intensified Russian air strikes as US peace talks continue
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian air defense has recorded a record number of air raid alerts as Russia intensifies its round-the-clock military strikes. In parallel, US envoys have presented new peace proposals in Kyiv, although officials have warned that the conflict is expected to remain prolonged.

top_stories.title: German far-right party wins state election amid mainstream political concern
top_stories.summary: The far-right Alternative for Germany party has won a major state election, triggering widespread concern among mainstream political figures about the future of German democracy. The historic result has forced mainstream parties to address the shifting political landscape and the possibility of working with the far-right.

top_stories.title: Kyiv faces record air strikes as diplomatic efforts to end war continue
top_stories.summary: Air raid alerts have reached record levels in Kyiv as Russian military forces launch continuous round-the-clock strikes across Ukraine. Meanwhile, international diplomatic efforts are ongoing, with US envoys presenting peace proposals while Ukrainian leaders warn of a prolonged conflict.

top_stories.summary: A German startup has successfully completed Europe's first commercial space launch, marking a significant milestone for the continent's space sector. The achievement demonstrates the growing capability of European private enterprises to compete in the global commercial space market.
